g.text: WEB02 - SD 4: Restore or change language with an unfinished form
Enter text and choose form values
Validate, publish locale and update document language
Apply in memory, report that saving failed
Same mounted form and draft, with localized labels
Update title and heading, preserve current focus
In-app navigation keeps the provider mounted.
On reload or later visit, the first flow runs again.
Locale changes do not navigate, remount the form or submit a write.
